title: Normalized quotient reduction and projection data
statement: For sites J,K small in the coefficient universe, a commutative ring A and ideal I, define constant sheaf coefficients and the actual successive quotient maps A/I^(n+2) to A/I^(n+1). A Reduction is ordinary extension to the quotient system with unit transition formula, its universal left-derived functor and its evaluated scalar-extension comparisons. A TensorReduction fixes the ordinary tensor comparison, its total-complex summands, K-flatness and preservation of flat terms, and its derived representative equation. A Presentation includes the module-induced ringed geometric adjunction, source and target reductions, and ordinary/derived pullback comparisons with their insertion and representative equations. Define the counit coefficient mate, balanced projection arrow and their finite evaluations; Laws expresses transitions, the specified finite counit, projection evaluation and naturality. All operations are on the ordinary module derived categories, with the coefficient and adjunction interfaces of the listed statement dependencies.
